Definition: Bethul (i.e. Bethuel), a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Bethul means "God destroys." It was a town of Simeon in the south (also spelled 'Bethuel'). You will find it in Joshua 19:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bethul is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
